featuredWorks.title: Campaign Identity System
featuredWorks.subtitle: Political Campaign Creative Direction
featuredWorks.challenge: The campaign needed a cohesive visual language that could perform across print, social, and event media in a short timeline.
featuredWorks.research: I audited competitor campaign visuals, audience response, and local visual cues to identify high-recall design patterns.
featuredWorks.design: Developed typography hierarchy, accent color system, and modular layouts for posters, feeds, and ad creatives.
featuredWorks.result: Delivered a consistent creative system that increased campaign recognition and improved social engagement.

featuredWorks.title: Responsive Portfolio Platform
featuredWorks.subtitle: Frontend + Motion-led Showcase
featuredWorks.challenge: The portfolio needed to stand out visually while keeping performance and maintainability high.
featuredWorks.research: Benchmarked modern agency portfolios and studied interaction patterns that improved user retention.
featuredWorks.design: Built a motion-first UI with modern layout rhythms, interactive sections, and clear content hierarchy.
featuredWorks.result: A distinctive, professional website that balances aesthetics, speed, and content control.

featuredWorks.title: Brand + Social Media Suite
featuredWorks.subtitle: Visual Storytelling for Business Growth
featuredWorks.challenge: The client had inconsistent visual assets and needed a recognizable voice across platforms.
featuredWorks.research: Analyzed audience behavior and campaign conversion patterns for tone, format, and visual timing.
featuredWorks.design: Created a scalable brand toolkit with ad templates, post systems, and campaign-ready layouts.
featuredWorks.result: Improved brand consistency and faster campaign turnaround with reusable, high-impact assets.
